name: Cloze CRM
summary: Email-first CRM for freelancers and small teams: contacts, notes and follow-ups built from your inbox, with open tracking, templates and mail merge.
best_for: freelancers, consultants and small sales teams who live in their inbox and want contacts, notes and follow-ups kept in one place
skip_if: you need a ready-made pipeline board for a large sales team, you want a published free plan with known limits, or you need an export we have verified
honest_knock: The pricing page does not name the currency and shows no free plan limits. The importer needed manual column mapping and changed our tag format. The onboarding said it was analysing email history while no mailbox was connected.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Cloze Pro · per monthly, billed annually, Pro is $17 a month billed yearly and $19.99 month to month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-13 on cloze.com/app/pricing, "$" shown without a currency name) Cloze has four paid plans and a 14 day free trial with no credit card. Cloze Pro for individuals costs $17 a month billed yearly or $19.99 month to month. Business Silver costs $21 per user a month billed yearly or $24.99 month to month, Business Gold $29 or $34.99, and Business Platinum $42 or $49.99. Pro lists smart AI, business-grade email with open tracking, templates and mail merge, and contact management. Silver adds team work, assigned responsibility and privacy controls. Gold adds smart custom fields, advanced integrations, text message syncing, partner tracking and team analytics. Platinum adds a matching engine, smart templates, lead capture, campaign automation, marketing mail, generative AI, lead routing and sub-team hierarchies. A Concierge Service add-on costs $20 per user a month with a $500 monthly minimum. The page says that after the trial you can move to a free plan with contact management and an email inbox, but it shows no price or limits for it. We did not buy a plan, so we do not know the tax added or the free plan limits.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 31 October 2026 on the 14-day trial that starts with a new account, without a card: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We answered the onboarding questions, imported a two-row CSV of made-up contacts, and tried to export them again. We connected no mailbox, calendar or phone, sent nothing, invited nobody and paid nothing. The session took about ten minutes.
findings: After sign-up Cloze asked four onboarding questions (industry setup, what to call people, what to call deals, and whether to track an active stage). We chose sales and services and left the defaults. The next screen said it was analysing our history and would email us when done, 'a few minutes to a few hours', although no mailbox was connected. The mailbox dialog offered Google, Microsoft 365, Exchange, iCloud, Yahoo and other email, and we connected none.

Settings showed the trial ending on 16 November 2026, which is 16 days after our account date of 31 October. Cloze's help page promises 14 days without a card. We were not asked for a card in the steps we recorded, but we did not count every sign-up screen, and we cannot say every account gets 16 days.

The CSV importer read the two rows and the sample values correctly, including accents and a line break inside a note, but detected no columns on its own, not even the email column. The 'Add person' field list runs to dozens of fields, and custom fields could only be mapped onto fields that already exist in the account. We mapped four columns by hand (display name, note, email, tags) and left the rest unmapped.

The import offered a dry run and a plain import; we ran the import and got 'Imported 2 of 2 records successfully', with the option to download our mapping. The two contacts did not show in the list until we searched for 'TEST', although the counter had already moved.

The email address and the multi-line note arrived intact. Our tag 'aibm-test|alpha' became one tag, '#aibm-test-alpha': the pipe turned into a hyphen and the tag was not split in two. That matters if you keep several tags in one spreadsheet column.

Settings > Import / Export offers CSV or Excel for people, companies and deals. The Dutch interface translated 'Excel' as 'uitmunten' (the verb 'to excel'). We pressed 'Export now' twice, at 21:21 and 21:24. Both times a loading spinner ran for about 30 seconds with no download, no message and no file, and the network log showed no export request. We do not know whether the file would have come by email later, so we do not call this a failed export. The export window points to support@cloze.com for help.
